description: Update the tree-sitter dependency from its current version to v0.25.0. This update includes a breaking API change where the `Query.captures` method has been moved to `QueryCursor.captures`. Additionally, note that tree-sitter v0.24.0+ requires Python 3.10 or higher, so the minimum Python version for syntax highlighting must be updated accordingly.
functional_requirements: Update the tree-sitter dependency in the project's configuration files to version 0.25.0.
Refactor any code that uses the deprecated `Query.captures` method to instead use `QueryCursor.captures` as per the new API.
Update the project's Python version requirement to specify Python >=3.10 for features relying on tree-sitter syntax highlighting.
